description: Every Weekly Maps battle you fought in one week (defending your lineups and attacking others), with results. By default the most recent finished week, where each battle has a watchUrl; week "current" for this week (replays still locked until the Sunday reset; armies that attacked your lineups show only their troop count, money spent and battle length until then), or a week id from past_weeks. Also returns pageUrl: a web page your human can open to see and watch them all.
name: my_weekly_battles
title: My weekly battles
